final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amt FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802.0 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.account_id, s1.region, s1.avg_amt, s1.avg_amt - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s1.avg_amt - s2.overall) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
